# Julius second live mission workspace

A throwaway repository, and deliberately NOT the first mission's task. It exists
so a live Julius mission can be proved on work it has never seen: reducing a
list of records rather than normalising a string, with a tie-break rule and two
distinguishable failure messages.

4 MiB, no network, no dependencies, and no path back to the Sunday Relay
repository. The mission's own contract states what must be built here.
